statement: Applied Materials, Inc.'s Semiconductor Systems segment designs, develops, manufactures, and sells a wide range of primarily 300mm equipment used to fabricate semiconductor chips.
The Semiconductor Systems segment includes the semiconductor capital equipment industry’s most comprehensive portfolio of products used in the chip making process.

CSX Corporation's forest products volume declined 4% in FY2025 Q1 compared to the prior year, reflecting an uncertain building products environment due to interest rates and changing trading policies.
Abbott Laboratories' Core Laboratory Diagnostics sales increased 7.3 percent in the first six months of 2024, excluding the effect of foreign exchange.

The growth in Core Laboratory Diagnostics was driven by increased adoption and utilization of Abbott's market-leading systems and global demand for testing menus in immunoassay, clinical chemistry, hematology, and blood screening.
Skyworks Solutions, Inc. authorized a stock repurchase program of up to $2.0 billion, expiring on February 1, 2025, under the Board of Directors' approval on January 31, 2023.
The stock repurchase program is subject to a 1% excise tax under the Inflation Reduction Act, which reduces the available amount for repurchases and is included in the cost of shares repurchased.
Yum! Brands, Inc. has approximately 275 restaurants in Middle East markets temporarily closed as of September 30, 2024.
Yum! Brands, Inc. defaulted a franchisee operating in the Middle East subsequent to the end of the third quarter of 2024.
Yum! Brands, Inc. expects foreign currency translation to negatively impact Divisional Operating Profit by $20 to $30 million for the full year 2024.
Nucor Corporation's steel products segment outside sales tonnage increased 9% in FY2025 Q1 compared to FY2024 Q1.
The increase in Nucor's steel products segment outside sales tonnage was driven by a 9% rise in tons sold to outside customers, partially offset by a 12% decrease in average sales price per ton.
Domino's Pizza, Inc. generates revenues and earnings by charging royalties and fees to franchisees, including percent-of-sales fees for the Domino's ® brand marks.
Domino's business model includes selling food, equipment, and supplies to franchisees through supply chain operations primarily in the U.S. and Canada.
NIKE, Inc. Revenues for the third quarter of fiscal 2024 were $12.43 billion compared to $12.39 billion for the third quarter of fiscal 2023.
NIKE Direct revenues were $5.4 billion for the third quarter of fiscal 2024 compared to $5.3 billion for the third quarter of fiscal 2023, representing approximately 45% of total NIKE Brand revenues.
Digital Realty Trust, Inc.'s net cash used in investing activities increased by $1,295,461 in the nine months ended September 30, 2024 compared to the same period in 2023.
The increase in net cash used in investing activities was primarily due to an increase in spend due to acquisitions of land parcels in Paris and two data centers located in the Slough Trading Estate.
A decrease in spend on development projects of approximately $370 million contributed to the change in net cash used in investing activities.
An increase in cash contributed to various investments in unconsolidated entities occurred.
News Corporation's Dow Jones segment revenues increased $15 million, or 3%, for the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the corresponding period of fiscal 2024.
The increase in Dow Jones segment revenues was primarily due to higher professional information business revenues.
Professional information business revenues increased $17 million, or 8%, during the three months ended September 30, 2024.
Nasdaq, Inc.'s Index revenues increased 26% in the first quarter of 2025 compared with the same period in 2024.
Fidelity National Information Services, Inc.'s Banking segment revenue increased 2% for the year ended December 31, 2024, compared to 2023.
The Banking segment's revenue growth was driven by a 3% contribution from recurring revenue, primarily due to higher transaction processing revenue.
A decline in non-recurring revenue offset the Banking segment's revenue growth by 1 percentage point in FY2024.
Teledyne Technologies Incorporated's Instrumentation segment net sales increased 4.3% in 2024 compared with 2023.
The Instrumentation segment's net sales increase included $22.3 million in incremental net sales from current and prior year acquisitions.
Marine instrumentation net sales within the Instrumentation segment increased $101.8 million in 2024 compared with 2023.
WEC Energy Group, Inc.'s Wisconsin segment net income attributed to common shareholders increased $93.5 million in the first quarter of 2025 compared to the first quarter of 2024.

AvalonBay Communities, Inc. seeks to increase operating income through innovative property management strategies, including associate engagement, resident satisfaction, and the use of technology and data science to optimize Net Operating Income (NOI).
The company employs a centralized shared services center and technology platform as part of its operating model to enhance efficiency and resident services.
M&T Bank Corporation's Institutional Services and Wealth Management segment net income was $535 million in 2024, a decrease of $85 million from 2023.
Solventum Corporation's Health Information Systems segment revenue increased 1.1% on an organic basis in FY2024.
International Business Machines Corporation's Hybrid Platform & Solutions revenue increased 9.8 percent in FY2024 Q3 compared to the prior-year period.
Red Hat revenue within IBM's Hybrid Platform & Solutions segment increased 13.7 percent in FY2024 Q3 compared to the prior-year period.
IBM's focused acquisition strategy contributed approximately 3 points to total Software revenue growth in FY2024 Q3.
PACCAR INC's worldwide truck net sales and revenues increased to $26.85 billion in 2023 from $21.49 billion in 2022.

The increase in PACCAR INC's worldwide truck net sales and revenues was primarily due to higher truck unit deliveries, improved price realization in all markets, and favorable currency translation effects, primarily the euro.
DexCom, Inc. has experienced manufacturing and inventory challenges for G7 that have resulted in disruptions in its ability to supply certain markets, including in the U.S. and other countries.
DexCom, Inc. may not be able to scale its manufacturing operations quickly enough to meet market demand for its CGM systems.
DexCom, Inc. has faced backorders and sales force limitations due to insufficient product supply in the past.
Assurant, Inc.'s Homeowners segment net earned premiums increased $75.9 million, or 15%, in Second Quarter 2024 compared to Second Quarter 2023.

Mohawk Industries, Inc. provides customers with a broad product line in the ceramic tile industry, including glazed floor tile, glazed wall tile, mosaic tile, porcelain tile, quarry tile, porcelain landscaping pavers, exterior cladding, stone products, porcelain slabs, quartz countertops, and installation products.
Mohawk Industries, Inc. sources products from other manufacturers in addition to its own ceramic tile business to enhance its offerings to customers.

Mohawk Industries, Inc. markets its ceramic tile products under multiple brand names, including American Olean, Daltile, Decortiles, Eliane, Elizabeth, EmilGroup, KAI, Kerama Marazzi, Marazzi, Ragno, and Vitromex.
Visa Inc.'s service revenue increased over the three-month prior-year comparable period primarily due to 6% growth in nominal payments volume.
Visa Inc.'s data processing revenue increased over the three-month prior-year comparable period primarily due to 11% growth in processed transactions.

Visa Inc.'s international transaction revenue increased over the three-month prior-year comparable period primarily due to growth in nominal cross-border volumes of 15%, excluding transactions within Europe.

Borg Warner Inc's strategy focuses on profitable growth across its technology-focused product portfolio supporting electric, hybrid, and combustion vehicles through growth in eProducts and Foundational products.
Borg Warner Inc's future success depends on making timely investments in the right customers and markets to support product development in evolving vehicle technologies.
Borg Warner Inc expects to continue pursuing business ventures, acquisitions, and strategic alliances to enhance its customer base, geographic representation, and scale.
Sysco Corporation increased its share repurchase expectations from $750.0 million to $1.25 billion for fiscal 2024.
Sysco expects to return $2.25 billion to shareholders in fiscal 2024 through share repurchases and dividends.
Sysco returned $353 million to shareholders via share repurchases and dividends in the recent quarter.
Huntington Ingalls Industries, Inc.'s total backlog was $48.0 billion as of March 31, 2025, and $48.7 billion as of December 31, 2024.
Approximately $28 billion of the total backlog as of March 31, 2025, is currently funded.
Yum! Brands, Inc.'s Company restaurant margin percentage decreased 0.4 percentage points in FY2024 Q3 compared to the previous period.
The decrease in Company restaurant margin percentage was partially offset by same-store sales growth of 2% in FY2024 Q3.

Phillips 66 acquired all issued and outstanding equity interests in EPIC Y-Grade GP, LLC and EPIC Y-Grade, LP on April 1, 2025, including their subsidiaries owning long haul NGL pipelines, fractionation facilities, and distribution systems.

The acquisition of EPIC Y-Grade GP, LLC and EPIC Y-Grade, LP is part of Phillips 66's strategy to grow its Midstream segment and integrate with its existing asset base for long-term fee-based earnings growth.
Globe Life Inc.'s American Income Division's average producing agent count increased 3% from 11,139 in 2024 to 11,510 in Q1 2025.
The increase in average producing agent count in the American Income Division was driven by new agent recruiting and improved retention.

Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated has activated more than 35 authorized treatment centers globally for CASGEVY, with patients initiating cell collection across all regions where the drug is approved.

The French National Authority for Health (HAS) approved an early access program for CASGEVY in indicated patients with Sickle Cell Disease (SCD), following prior approval for Thalassemia (TDT) in Q1 2024.
Zebra Technologies Corporation's EVM segment Net sales increased $401 million or 13.7% for FY2024 compared to FY2023.
EVM Organic Net sales growth of 13.2% excludes the impacts of foreign currency changes and acquisitions.

Teradyne, Inc. is a leading global supplier of automated test equipment and robotics solutions, including semiconductor test systems, robotics products, and defense/aerospace test instrumentation and systems.
In 2024, Teradyne's Semiconductor Test business experienced strength, with memory and compute offerings growing considerably compared to 2023.
Teradyne expects mobile, automotive, and industrial markets to grow in 2025, potentially aided by advancements in AI inference.
Starbucks had more than 39,400 company-operated and licensed stores as of June 30, 2024, representing a 6% increase from the prior year.
Equity Residential had approximately $2.3 billion in readily available liquidity as of the six months ended June 30, 2024.
The Company's liquidity position is supported by a strong balance sheet, limited near-term debt maturities, and very strong credit metrics.
Equity Residential believes it is well positioned to meet future obligations and capitalize on opportunities due to ample access to capital markets.
NIKE, Inc.'s NIKE Brand revenues increased 2% on a reported and currency-neutral basis in FY2024 Q3.
The NIKE Brand revenue increase was driven by higher revenues in Men's, Kids', Women's, and the Jordan Brand.
NIKE Brand footwear revenues increased 3% on a currency-neutral basis in FY2024 Q3.
NIKE Brand wholesale revenues increased 3% compared to the third quarter of fiscal 2023 on a reported and currency-neutral basis.
Expedia Group's lodging segment accounted for 82% of total worldwide revenue in the third quarter of 2024.

Applied Materials, Inc.'s effective tax rate for the third quarter of fiscal 2024 was lower than the same period in the prior fiscal year primarily due to larger excess tax benefits from share-based compensation in fiscal 2024.

The effective tax rate for the first nine months of fiscal 2024 was higher than the same period in the prior fiscal year primarily due to lower tax credits in fiscal 2024, partially offset by larger excess tax benefits from share-based compensation in fiscal 2024.
VALERO ENERGY CORP/TX's Refining segment margin was negatively impacted by a decrease in distillate margins of approximately $4.3 billion in 2024 compared to 2023.
VALERO ENERGY CORP/TX's Refining segment margin was negatively impacted by a decrease in gasoline margins of approximately $2.4 billion in 2024 compared to 2023.
VALERO ENERGY CORP/TX's Refining segment margin was negatively impacted by a decline in crude oil differentials of approximately $585 million in 2024 compared to 2023.
VALERO ENERGY CORP/TX's Refining segment margin was negatively impacted by a decrease in throughput volumes of 67,000 barrels per day in 2024 compared to 2023.
VALERO ENERGY CORP/TX's Refining segment operating expenses (excluding depreciation and amortization) decreased by $262 million in 2024 compared to 2023.
PulteGroup, Inc. repurchased 7.6 million shares under its repurchase authorization for $880.0 million in the nine months ended September 30, 2024.
The share repurchase program included a $1.5 billion increase in authorization on January 30, 2024, leaving $1.0 billion remaining at September 30, 2024.
Chubb Limited's net premiums written increased $449 million and $1,021 million for the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, respectively, compared to the same periods in 2023.

The growth in commercial lines of insurance contributed to the increase in net premiums written, with a 13.3% and 12.7% increase for the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, respectively, on a constant-dollar basis.

Essex Property Trust, Inc. stated that domestic policy actions, including tariff discussions, and geopolitical tensions have increased economic uncertainty, with long-term impacts dependent on job growth, inflation, the broader economy, and reactions from consumers, companies, governmental entities, and capital markets.
The Company indicated that the heightened economic uncertainty has not materially affected its access to traditional funding sources or its ability to meet debt covenants and obligations.
3M Company determined a discount rate of 5.64% for its U.S. pension plans and 5.68% for its postretirement benefit plans as of December 31, 2024.
The increase in discount rates during 2024 resulted in an approximate $0.7 billion decrease in benefit obligation for the U.S. pension and postretirement plans compared to December 31, 2023.
3M Company’s 2025 expected long-term rate of return on U.S. plan assets is 8.00%.
IQVIA Holdings Inc.'s Technology & Analytics Solutions segment's cost of revenues, exclusive of depreciation and amortization, increased $225 million, or 6.4%, in FY2024 compared to 2023.

The increase in Technology & Analytics Solutions' cost of revenues included a constant currency increase of approximately $261 million, or 7.5%, primarily due to higher compensation and related expenses.
Technology & Analytics Solutions' selling, general and administrative expenses increased $41 million, or 4.7%, in FY2024 compared to 2023.

The increase in Technology & Analytics Solutions' selling, general and administrative expenses included a constant currency increase of approximately $52 million, or 5.9%, mainly from higher compensation and related expenses.

Cboe Global Markets, Inc. reported total revenues of $1,055.7 million for the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to $908.8 million for the same period in 2023, representing a $146.9 million increase or 16% growth.

Cboe Global Markets, Inc. reported total revenues of $2,986.9 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2024, compared to $2,804.8 million for the same period in 2023, representing an $182.1 million increase or 6% growth.

Synopsys, Inc. has customers that are subject to U.S. government controls on advanced computing ICs and semiconductor manufacturing items, which may impact product or service deployment in international markets.
Synopsys, Inc. depends on a relatively small number of large customers, and customer consolidation or reduced spending by these customers could negatively impact its operating results.
Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. experienced content delivery delays in the first quarter of 2024 due to the pause in television productions in 2023.
The strikes by WGA and SAG-AFTRA had a material impact on the Company's operations and results in 2023, including a pause on certain theatrical and television productions.
